reset.name: i_axis_arstn
reset.values: all pipeline valid and output data/tag registers clear; external synchronous release

behavior: 真实AXI参数装载、草稿提交、重试、声音+LFO+FX满负载时限和独立尾音。
constraints: Verilog-2001; single 50MHz clock; signed Q26 audio, signed 18-bit Q16 feedback RAM.
See FX.md for numerical equations, command layout and limits. No board timing claim.
Clear only while idle, RAM validity reset without clearing memory contents. Reset cancels in-flight work.
corner_cases: changing tags and parameters every accepted beat
verification_cases: Independent integer model, stereo impulses and random full-scale inputs
Fractional and maximum delay, bypass, clipping and zero-input tail decay
Backpressure and reset; independent command replay; atomic parameter commit; 1024-clock deadline
